name: muon
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Muon displays an explicit warning for unverifiable software and requires the user to continue before replying to the transaction; package verification remains in its backend.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
